keywords.term: AI agent for CRM data entry
keywords.note: content/news/2026-07-16-ai-agent-crm-data-entry (en+zh). Capture-vs-maintain framing: an auto-logging layer that records emails/calls/meetings onto records (Salesforce Einstein Activity Capture, HubSpot Breeze, Lindy) vs a data-steward that fills and enriches the structured fields forecasting reads from (HubSpot Breeze Data Agent, Zapier CRM data management). Grounded in Issue #001's bucket/priority pattern; clusters with meeting-prep (woven the CRM-log link into its Route 3) and the founders/recruiters/lead-qualification sales family.

content/news/2026-07-18-ai-agent-for-lead-qualification (en+zh). Score-vs-engage framing: a silent scoring/routing layer that ranks inbound leads and hands hot ones to a rep (Zapier BANT lead-qualification build, Lindy enrich-and-rank, Dynamics 365 Sales Qualification Agent research-only mode; real named build = JBGoodwin REALTORS via Zapier, 37% recruiting lift / 20-25% less manual work) vs an agent that engages the lead directly (Dynamics 365 research-and-engage mode). Grounded in Issue #001's P0/P1/P2 pattern = fit/urgency scoring; clusters with crm-data-entry (wove upstream link into its 'Which do you need' section), customer-support-triage (sort-vs-resolve parallel), meeting-prep.

keywords.note: content/news/2026-07-15-ai-agent-customer-support-triage (en+zh). Grounded in Issue #001's bucket/priority pattern; clusters with email-management and slack-summaries (all 'triage the firehose').

Sibling keyword 'AI agent for social media content' (distribution step) still new.
